name: Pharmacology Focus
tagline: Ocular and Systemic Pharmacology for Optometrists
description: A 15-episode series on the drugs optometrists prescribe and the systemic drugs that affect the eye — from mydriatics to hydroxychloroquine screening.

episodes.title: Mydriatics and Cycloplegics: Phenylephrine, Tropicamide, and Cyclopentolate
episodes.description: The onset and duration of each dilating drop, the cycloplegic vs mydriatic distinction, and the allergy and contraindication profile.

episodes.title: Topical Antibiotics: Fluoroquinolones, Aminoglycosides, and the Resistance Picture
episodes.description: The spectrum of each antibiotic class, the fluoroquinolone generations, and when fortified antibiotics are preferred over monotherapy.

episodes.title: Topical Antivirals: Acyclovir, Ganciclovir, and the HSV Treatment
episodes.description: The topical antiviral options, the oral acyclovir role in stromal and endothelial HSV, and the long-term suppression protocol.

episodes.title: Topical Corticosteroids: Potency, Side Effects, and the IOP Spike Risk
episodes.description: The steroid potency ladder (loteprednol to difluprednate), the IOP response risk, and the "steroid responder" monitoring protocol.

episodes.title: Glaucoma Medications Overview: The Seven Drug Classes
episodes.description: The seven classes (PGAs, beta-blockers, alpha-2, CAIs, miotics, rho-kinase, nitric oxide), their mechanism, and the sequencing algorithm.

episodes.title: Prostaglandin Analogue Side Effects: Iris Pigmentation and Periorbitopathy
episodes.description: The irreversible iris darkening, the prostaglandin-associated periorbitopathy (fat atrophy, deep sulcus), and the patient counselling.

episodes.title: Allergy Eye Drops: Antihistamines, Mast Cell Stabilisers, and Dual-Action Agents
episodes.description: The olopatadine dual mechanism, the onset of action of each drop, and when a topical steroid is the right escalation.

episodes.title: Prescription Dry Eye Drops: Cyclosporine, Lifitegrast, and Varenicline
episodes.description: The immunomodulatory mechanism of cyclosporine, the LFA-1 inhibition of lifitegrast, and the varenicline nasal spray for tear production.

episodes.title: Topical NSAIDs: Ketorolac, Bromfenac, and Nepafenac in Eye Care
episodes.description: The role of NSAIDs in post-cataract inflammation, the corneal melt risk with prolonged use, and the pseudophakic cystoid macular edema prevention.

episodes.title: Topical Anesthetics: Proper Use and the Dangers of Chronic Abuse
episodes.description: The legitimate uses of proparacaine and tetracaine, the keratopathy of chronic anesthetic abuse, and the patient who requests refills.

episodes.title: Ocular Side Effects of Systemic Drugs: Hydroxychloroquine, Ethambutol, and Amiodarone
episodes.description: The classic drug-induced ocular toxicities, the screening schedule for each, and the early signs that mandate drug cessation.

episodes.title: Hydroxychloroquine Screening: The 2016 AAO Guidelines and OCT Findings
episodes.description: The daily dose (≤5mg/kg real body weight), the baseline and annual screening tests, and the "bull's eye" maculopathy on OCT and FAF.

episodes.title: Ethambutol Toxicity: Optic Neuropathy and the TB Patient Monitoring
episodes.description: The dose-dependent optic neuropathy, the baseline and monthly visual acuity and colour vision testing, and the cessation of drug.

episodes.title: Amiodarone and the Eye: Vortex Keratopathy and Optic Neuropathy
episodes.description: The cornea verticillata finding, the rare amiodarone optic neuropathy, and the monitoring protocol for the cardiology patient.

episodes.title: Drug Interactions in Eye Care: Systemic Absorption and the Punctal Occlusion Technique
episodes.description: How topical drops reach the systemic circulation (nasolacrimal), the punctal occlusion technique to reduce systemic absorption, and the beta-blocker asthma risk.
